title: Fuse negation into the signed half in 4W+1 transitions (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A scoped written proof and literal reversible table reduce the negative stochastic half's exact worst-case cost from `6W+2` to **`4W+1` transitions per direction** for all signed widths `W >= 2`. The bound is attained at `x=0` with either coin. The work tape uses the same six glyphs and one retained parity cell. Both heads return and the resident coin is read only.

For `x=2q+p`, the shift writes `~q` directly and the ripple adds `1-pu`. Their sum is `-q-pu`, so the table needs no separate negation scan. The written proof covers both directions, the exact inverse image and the timing bound. [Proof and table](research/fused-negative-half-tape/README.md)

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ToikY's #6809 for the negative-half baseline and transition-constant question, Nick Petalas's #6801 for the marked shift, and zxv's #6092 and #6066 for the signed-half and restoration contract. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19693311)

## Evidence

On CPython 3.12.15, both direct checks and both registered commands passed. Each direct invocation replayed 70 expanded rows, 4,088 exhaustive and 240 translated round trips, all 2,032 inverse boundary points through width eight, and five rejecting controls. The direct invocations took 0.22 and 0.21 seconds locally. Committed bytes, modes and source ancestry passed for all six package files.

Run from the repository root. On another machine use its CPython 3.12 executable.

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/fused-negative-half-tape/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/fused-negative-half-tape/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fused-negative-half-tape
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fused-negative-half-tape --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The supplied marks and resident coin are part of the local contract. Optimality over other machines, physical encoding, coin delivery, native MOVE and a complete supplier invoice remain open. The selected cold replay, predecessor scientific suites and formal proof-kernel checks are outside this package's replay scope. The result is local and carries no κ claim.

## Open next questions

Bind one reached negative half to this layout. Charge signed width, marker setup, coin delivery, retention of parity and return-state sequencing before comparing complete caller costs.

## Related open work

- #7595 charges a different signed half-copy inside an actual caller. Its source-preserving ADD contact and this stochastic half's in-place parity interface have separate entry and return requirements.

The run completed the plan and both registered package replays for `research/historical-selected-replay-gap` and `research/fused-negative-half-tape`.
